title: SpaceX Plans Bold Move After Successful Starship Test
subtitle: Following a perfect landing in the Indian Ocean, SpaceX aims to catch its next Starship with the launch tower.

summary.en: SpaceX recently completed the 13th test flight of its Starship rocket. The vehicle traveled from Texas to the Indian Ocean and landed in one piece. This was a major improvement over previous tests that ended in fires. Engineers are now studying the ship's heat shield to prepare for future missions. SpaceX plans to attempt a tower catch on the next flight.
summary.zh: SpaceX 近期完成了星艦火箭的第十三次試飛。該載具從德州飛行至印度洋並完整降落。這與過去以起火告終的測試相比有顯著進步。工程師目前正在研究太空船的隔熱罩，為未來的任務做準備。SpaceX 計畫在下一次飛行中嘗試進行發射塔捕捉。

paragraphs.en: SpaceX has reached a major milestone in its space program. On Friday, the company successfully completed the 13th test flight of its Starship rocket. The massive vehicle traveled halfway around the world from its launch site in South Texas to a remote area of the Indian Ocean. Unlike previous attempts, which often ended in explosions or fires, this flight concluded with a gentle, intact splashdown in the water.
paragraphs.zh: 太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）在其太空計畫中達成了一項重大里程碑。週五，該公司成功完成了星艦（Starship）火箭的第十三次試飛。這枚巨大的載具從德州南部的發射場出發，飛行了半個地球，最終抵達印度洋的偏遠海域。與以往經常以爆炸或起火告終的嘗試不同，這次飛行以平穩且完整的姿態落入海中。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, this successful landing is a significant step forward for the team. In previous missions, the Starship vehicle was destroyed upon hitting the water. This time, the ship remained floating and in good condition after its hour-long journey. This achievement allows engineers to collect valuable data that was previously impossible to obtain. The company used drones to inspect the ship’s heat shield, which is made of more than 18,000 ceramic tiles designed to protect the rocket from extreme heat during its return to Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導，這次成功降落對團隊而言是向前邁進的重要一步。在先前的任務中，星艦載具在觸水時便會損毀。這一次，太空船在歷經一小時的航程後，仍保持漂浮且狀態良好。這項成就讓工程師得以收集過去無法取得的寶貴數據。該公司利用無人機檢查了太空船的隔熱罩，該隔熱罩由超過一萬八千片陶瓷磚組成，旨在保護火箭在重返地球時免受極端高溫的影響。

paragraphs.en: Managing the heat shield is one of the biggest challenges for the Starship program. For SpaceX to reach its goal of flying the rocket multiple times per day, the heat shield must be very strong. It needs to survive the intense vibrations and temperatures of space travel without needing to be replaced after every flight. Dan Huot, a communications manager at SpaceX, noted during a live broadcast that having an intact ship in the water is a "dream scenario" for the team. The ability to study a ship that did not burn up or break apart provides critical information for future designs.
paragraphs.zh: 管理隔熱罩是星艦計畫面臨的最大挑戰之一。為了達成每日多次飛行火箭的目標，隔熱罩必須非常堅固。它需要能夠承受太空旅行的劇烈震動與高溫，且無需在每次飛行後進行更換。SpaceX 的通訊經理丹·胡特（Dan Huot）在直播中指出，太空船能完整地落在水面上對團隊來說是「夢寐以求的情境」。能夠研究一艘沒有燒毀或解體的太空船，為未來的設計提供了關鍵資訊。

paragraphs.en: Because the vehicle survived the landing so well, SpaceX may even be able to tow it to shore in Australia for a closer look. While the ship is not designed to be reused after touching salt water, the physical inspection of the tiles will help the company refine its technology. The rocket’s six Raptor engines also appeared to be in good condition, as seen through cameras on the ship that continued to send signals back to Earth through the Starlink satellite network.
paragraphs.zh: 由於載具在降落時保存得相當完好，SpaceX 甚至可能將其拖回澳洲岸邊進行更近距離的檢查。雖然太空船的設計並非為了在接觸鹽水後重複使用，但對陶瓷磚進行實體檢查將有助於公司改良技術。透過船上持續經由星鏈（Starlink）衛星網路傳回地球訊號的攝影機觀察，火箭的六具猛禽（Raptor）引擎看起來也處於良好狀態。

paragraphs.en: Encouraged by these results, SpaceX is already looking toward the next mission. Elon Musk, the founder and CEO of SpaceX, shared his plans on the social media platform X. He stated that, unless the data review shows unexpected problems, the company will attempt to catch the Starship with the launch tower on the next flight. This process involves using large mechanical arms on the launch tower to grab the ship as it slows down and hovers in the air. SpaceX has already successfully used this method with its Super Heavy booster, which is the massive lower part of the rocket system. However, catching the Starship itself will be a new and difficult challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 受到這些成果的鼓舞，SpaceX 已經開始展望下一次任務。SpaceX 的創辦人兼執行長伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）在社群媒體平台 X 上分享了他的計畫。他表示，除非數據審查顯示出意料之外的問題，否則公司將在下一次飛行中嘗試用發射塔捕捉星艦。這個過程涉及在火箭減速並懸停於空中時，利用發射塔上的大型機械手臂將其抓住。SpaceX 已經成功對超級重型（Super Heavy）推進器——即火箭系統巨大的下半部——使用了這種方法。然而，捕捉星艦本身將是一項全新且艱鉅的挑戰。

paragraphs.en: This 13th flight was the second test of the latest version of the rocket, known as Starship Version 3. Standing at 408 feet (124 meters) tall, it remains the most powerful rocket ever built. The success of this mission shows that the company is moving quickly toward its goal of making space travel more frequent and reliable. By moving from simple splashdowns to a potential tower catch, SpaceX is testing whether it can make its operations more efficient and precise.
paragraphs.zh: 這次第十三次飛行是該火箭最新版本「星艦第三版」的第二次測試。它高達四百零八英尺（一百二十四公尺），仍是有史以來建造過最強大的火箭。這次任務的成功顯示，該公司正迅速朝著讓太空旅行更頻繁且可靠的目標邁進。從簡單的落海回收轉向潛在的發射塔捕捉，SpaceX 正在測試其運作是否能更有效率且精準。

paragraphs.en: As the team reviews the information from this flight, the focus remains on durability. The company wants to ensure that the heat shield can handle the high stress of launch and reentry without failing. If the next attempt to catch the ship with the tower is successful, it would mark another huge leap for the program. For now, the successful splashdown in the Indian Ocean serves as proof that the design is heading in the right direction. The world will be watching closely to see if the next flight can turn this recent success into a routine operation.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著團隊審視此次飛行的資訊，焦點仍放在耐用性上。公司希望確保隔熱罩能承受發射與重返大氣層時的高壓而不失效。如果下一次嘗試用發射塔捕捉太空船的計畫成功，將標誌著該計畫的另一大躍進。目前，在印度洋的成功落海證明了設計方向正確。全世界將密切關注下一次飛行是否能將近期這項成功轉化為常規運作。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be destroyed by fire or extreme heat.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於描述物體進入大氣層時因高溫而毀損。文中：The ability to study a ship that did not burn up or break apart provides critical information for future designs.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To pull a vehicle or boat along behind another vehicle or boat.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此處指用船隻將火箭殘骸拖回岸邊。文中：Because the vehicle survived the landing so well, SpaceX may even be able to tow it to shore in Australia for a closer look.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To intercept and hold something that is moving through the air.
keyTerms.noteZh: 在此語境下指利用機械手臂在空中攔截火箭，而非一般的「抓取」。文中：He stated that, unless the data review shows unexpected problems, the company will attempt to catch the Starship with the launch tower on the next flight.

This was a major improvement over previous tests that ended in fires. Engineers are now studying the heat shield to see how it handled the extreme temperatures of space travel. SpaceX plans to attempt to catch the next ship using large mechanical arms on the launch tower.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason SpaceX engineers consider the 13th test flight a significant milestone?

options.A: It was the first time the Starship reached the Indian Ocean.
options.B: The vehicle remained intact, allowing for the inspection of its heat shield.
options.C: The rocket successfully used mechanical arms to land on the launch tower.
options.D: The Raptor engines were successfully reused after being recovered from the water.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，這次飛行最重要的突破在於船體在水中保持完整，這讓工程師能檢查由 18,000 片陶瓷磚組成的隔熱罩。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章未提及這是首次抵達印度洋；選項 C 錯誤，因為塔台捕捉技術是預計在「下一趟」飛行才進行的實驗；選項 D 錯誤，文章明確提到船體接觸鹽水後並非設計為重複使用，目前的重點是檢查而非回收再利用。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why is the durability of the heat shield critical for SpaceX's long-term business model?

options.A: To prevent the rocket from sinking when it lands in the ocean.
options.B: To allow the rocket to carry heavier payloads into deep space.
options.C: To enable the rocket to be flown multiple times per day without frequent maintenance.
options.D: To ensure the Starlink satellite network can communicate with the rocket during reentry.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，SpaceX 的目標是讓火箭能「每天飛行多次」，因此隔熱罩必須足夠強韌，能在不需每次飛行後更換的情況下承受極端溫度與震動。選項 A 與隔熱罩功能無關；選項 B 文章未提及載重問題；選項 D 雖然提到 Starlink 與通訊，但這是為了傳輸數據，而非隔熱罩的主要商業目的。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'routine' mean as it is used in the context of SpaceX's future operations?

options.A: A fixed and boring sequence of tasks.
options.B: A regular, standard, and predictable procedure.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在最後一段中，作者提到希望將最近的成功轉變為「routine operation」，意指將目前具挑戰性的測試轉化為常規、標準化且可預測的作業流程。選項 A 的「乏味」並非此處語境；選項 C 與「routine」意思相反；選項 D 雖描述了目前的飛行狀態，但「routine」強調的是穩定性而非危險性。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of this article regarding the Starship program?

options.A: The history of rocket explosions in the Starship program.
options.B: The technical specifications and height of the Starship Version 3.
options.C: The challenges of landing a rocket in the Indian Ocean.
options.D: The progress toward making space travel more efficient through successful testing and design refinement.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章圍繞著第 13 次飛行測試的成功，討論如何透過數據收集、隔熱罩改良以及未來的塔台捕捉計畫，來達成讓太空旅行更頻繁、更可靠的長期目標。選項 A 僅是背景資訊；選項 B 是細節描述；選項 C 僅是測試過程中的一個環節，而非全文主旨。
